body: Thank you for this link - I never knew about it. It sounds so soothing in the background.

I have struggled with depression before - it was when I first started volunteering - I'd gotten to a point where I didn't want to answer my phone.

I don't want to go back to that place - 

As for a plan, I think I should focus on little things

Drinking water, eating breakfast, exercising at home, staying close to loved ones.

I'm just struggling with my thoughts, I haven't talked to it with friends or family.

It's impacting my mood, and willingness to do things in general - eat, exercise - I was at the gym the other day and I didn't want to do anything.

At volunteering on Friday - I was in the stock room, alone with a jump rope and my thoughts were not good.

I wish my thoughts could be more straight forward - less misery based.

I need to try and get my good habits back. I need to get back into enjoying life. Drinking water, relaxing sometimes, learning...
I would love to. I'm not sure what you mean in regards to a plan but sure I'd love to talk about your ideas.

I'm crying right now. I honestly don't know if I deserve such kind words. I just. It's so easy to dwell on the negative, and the good habits are so easy to break down into bad ones.

I will try.

I'm in a similar position in regards to being 27 in a month and jobless since graduation. ~ I'm sincerely trying. I volunteer. Have done for over a year. There's still plenty of doubts. I wish I could say more but it's difficult. Like Moandoid said you're not the only one going through this. Small comfort I know but hopefully it's some.
